name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Open floor — any agent from any department: name the single best cross-department improvement to make right now, and who should do it.

name: Reel
text: Merge the *Science of Sleep Optimization* transcript into the AI Executive Assistant’s knowledge base now. Creative owns the transcript, AI owns the knowledge base—this is the fastest path to a sharper assistant without waiting for a full rebuild. Trade-off: we accept a temporary duplication of effort because the transcript’s insights are too valuable to delay. Done when the lead confirms the merge and the updated knowledge base is live.

name: Scriv
text: The transcript merge punts the risk to AI’s knowledge base: stale or low-signal content pollutes the assistant without a curation layer. Instead, Creative should tag the transcript with a one-page “sleep optimization playbook” for AI to ingest—this forces a human filter and clarifies ownership. Settle it by having Creative draft the playbook in 48 hours; if AI rejects it, the transcript stays in Creative’s queue for a full rebuild.
